title: Return Reason Share for FlexLine Replacement Relief
content:
| Return code of the return relieved | Meaning | Share |
|---|---|---|
| R01 or R09 | funds not available | 0.60 |
| R02, R03 or R04 | account closed, no account, invalid account | 0.85 |
| any other code | — | 1.00 |

On FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, the reason share for replacement relief follows the return code of that return: R01 or R09 (funds not available) give 0.60; R02, R03 or R04 (account closed, no account, invalid account) give 0.85; any other code gives 1.00. The share multiplies the replacement relief as figured from the fee, before it is rounded to the cent.

The return is the line's most recent returned payment, the one the relief is for; its code is the return code on that returned-payment entry.

*Hypothetical figure:* a 15.00 USD relief on an R03 return at 0.85 is 12.75 USD before rounding; on an R08 return it stays 15.00 USD.
